claims: Pet sitting provides in-home care, feeding, and companionship for pets.
Typical pet sitting services range from $30-$45 per day for drop-ins or overnights.
Qualified pet sitters are found on platforms like Rover or PetSitter.com.
Qualified pet sitters offer services like walking, medication administration, and home security.
Pet sitting drop-in visits often last 30-60 minutes.
Pet sitting drop-in visits focus on feeding, potty breaks, and playtime.
Pet sitting overnight stays involve a sitter staying at the pet owner's home.
Pet sitting overnight stays often cost around $45-$250+ per day.
Specific pet needs such as medication affect pet sitting costs.
Many platforms like Rover and PetSitter.com provide background-checked sitters.
